scientific_integrity: Polynomial identities and multiplier classifications have a standalone exact-arithmetic reproducer. The openness conclusion is a proof via the real implicit-function theorem, not an extrapolation from experiments. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Complete census concerns fixed points of the two-step epoch map, not all higher-period or globally attracting states; the open robustness neighborhood is not quantified. Priority is conditional on inspected sources and awaits independent review.
title: Robust coexistence of optimal and nonoptimal attractors under alternating quartic gradient steps
